Title: Better Auth: Account takeover via pre-account hijacking on magic-link and email-OTP sign-in
Description: An attacker can keep password access to a victim's account after the victim starts using it. The attack runs in three steps. First, with open registration, the attacker signs up using the victim's email and a password the attacker picks. The account stays unverified, so the attacker cannot use it yet. Later the real owner signs in with a magic link or an email OTP. That step marks the account verified, and the attacker's password now works on it.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 1.1.3 before 1.6.22, all versions starting from 1.7.0-beta.0 before 1.7.0-beta.10
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.1.3, all versions starting from 1.6.22 before 1.7.0-beta.0, all versions starting from 1.7.0-beta.10
